statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Kushala builds Blessings through well-timed blocks and uses SP2 to apply Soul Barb before further Incinerates from SP1. Special Damage is worth testing against the direct special-hit portion of that rotation. It must not be assumed to boost Soul Barb or Incinerate damage over time; compare complete fights at equivalent Blessing stacks.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration is a defensive-pressure trial only when Kushala's defender specials or attacks connect into an opponent's Block. It does not improve her Blessing acquisition, Soul Barb or Incinerate potency; compare a resistance focus if incoming damage or matchup survival is the priority.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Onslaught builds Neuroshock and converts it into Degeneration using SP2. Special Damage is a trial for connected special-hit damage, not an automatic multiplier of Neuroshock or Degeneration ticks. Compare the same Neuroshock stacks and total fight time before treating it as the preferred attacker setting.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration could add pressure only on attacks the opposing player blocks. It does not strengthen Neuroshock, Degeneration, Delirium or Crush, so compare it with a defensive mitigation option in matchups where the attacker does not block.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: The Serpent develops Dread and Culforce before a buff- and SP2-driven burst. Critical Rating may improve direct hits that are eligible to crit, but it is not a guaranteed boost to his Fury, Power Gain or any noncritical damage. Compare equivalent Culforce and Dread stacks in the same matchup.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration is a trial for his block pressure while cycling buffs and specials; it does not increase Culforce or extend Death Immunity. Evaluate it against resistance options when the defending fight is decided by incoming damage instead of hits into Block.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Human Torch builds Temperature through safe heavy openings and applies Incinerate or Nova Flame while baiting enemy specials. Block Proficiency is a survival-oriented setup trial where blocking is unavoidable; it does not increase Temperature, Incinerate or Nova Flame damage. Compare actual health remaining with a direct-damage alternative.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration affects attacks made into the opponent's Block, not Temperature, Smoulder, Incinerate or Nova Flame. It is a matchup-specific pressure option and must be compared against mitigation when the attacker does not block Torch's offense.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Warlock establishes Virus/Infection, refreshes it with SP2, and may spend Infections on SP1 power control. Critical Rating is a direct-hit damage trial only; it does not imply greater Infection-based heal prevention or Power Burn. Compare damage and control reliability at matching Infection counts.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration can add defender pressure only through actual hits into Block. It does not prolong Infection, bypass immunity or improve the power-control side of Warlock's kit; compare a mitigation focus against attackers that avoid block damage.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: High Evolutionary builds detonation charges while using well-timed blocks, then places an Evolutionary Field with SP2 and detonates with SP1. Block Proficiency is a health-preserving setup trial, not a direct boost to Combo Detonation. Compare a Special Damage alternative only on eligible special-hit damage at equal charge counts.

It does not increase the strength of the field, Combo Detonation or debuff application; compare resistance under the same attacking matchup.

statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Black Panther (Civil War) builds Reflect Charges using well-timed blocks and SP1 while Reflective Matrix is active, then releases Kinetic Burst. statFocusRecommendation.attackReason: Editorial rationale: Bullseye's guaranteed critical hits make Critical Damage Rating a more direct trial than extra crit chance on those guaranteed hits. Test against critical resistance and separate critical special-hit damage from Instant Bleed before concluding it is best.
statFocusRecommendation.defenseReason: Block Penetration is a pressure trial for attacks or specials that the opponent blocks. It does not increase Killer Instinct, Instant Bleed or guarantee an opening; compare physical resistance where the attacking player avoids blocking.
